MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick felt useful because it could add streaming to the television I already own, although 4K is not a benefit for my 720p set.",
    "Connecting recommendations to my existing television made sense: I have bought both a TV and a DVD player, so another way to watch content has some appeal."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My tripods, film, and lens cap support taking photographs; surveillance cameras and a video doorbell serve a different purpose that I do not currently need.",
    "USB-C cables and a directional DisplayPort cable do not match a connection need I have identified. My cable purchases have involved specific Micro USB, Mini USB, and 30-pin devices.",
    "Buying removable memory cards does not mean I need an internal SSD; that would require a computer upgrade and confirmed compatibility.",
    "My Fire tablet and car accessories do not make Alexa devices natural next purchases, and interest in streaming does not give me a reason to buy a gaming controller."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seemed to be treated as broad interest in Echo devices, Alexa, and other Amazon electronics.",
    "Shared words such as camera, memory, and cable seemed to matter more than whether the products perform the same job or fit my equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories for equipment I already use, including mounts, card readers, storage cases, and replacement cables.",
    "Exact fit matters to me: connector type, memory format, lens size, and the device an accessory supports determine whether I can use it.",
    "My repeated photography accessory purchases and most recent lens cap purchase provide a clearer reason for related accessories than for starting a smart-home setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but often missed the specific equipment and practical needs behind my purchases."
}
